title: Original anime brush catalog
status: 200 built-in catalog defaults; artistic and physical Huion acceptance pending

capability_definitions.multi-tip: Tip sets with deterministic random, ordered and no-immediate-repeat selection
capability_definitions.anchors: Per-tip root/baseline anchors and orientation constraints
capability_definitions.large-tip: Painting beyond the current 256 px nominal limit with bounded caching and benchmarks
capability_definitions.segment-repeat: Length-aware fitted repeats and stable phase along a path
capability_definitions.ribbon: Continuous path-deformed segments with joined ends
capability_definitions.color-pattern: Full-color tiled pattern painting rather than alpha modulation
capability_definitions.perspective-pattern: Pattern mapping over an explicit perspective plane
capability_definitions.tone: Independent tone frequency, density, angle and export-aware scaling
capability_definitions.color-stamp-tint: Opt-in tint/color variation for source-colored RGBA stamps
capability_definitions.speed: Validated speed sensor with event-rate-independent response
